messages:
Anika Patel: Quick heads-up — Skylife deployment has flatlined after week 2. Product usage down ~45% vs expected. Renews in 28 days. Thinking a lightweight 'warm handoff' mini-playbook to prevent churn. Thoughts?

Lee Morgan: Yikes. Can we confirm top blockers from onboarding survey? last NPS was 5/10 but notes vague. :thinking_face:

Carlos Ruiz: I pulled logs — most users hit the embeddings step and dropped. Error rate low, but latency spikes during batch uploads. Could be perf or docs gap.

Priya Shah: I can run a targeted enablement session for their PM + 2 engineers tomorrow. Short workshop + checklist might move the needle.

Anika Patel: Proposed mini-play: 1) Quick health triage (this thread) 2) 30-min enablement w/ demo + config audit 3) Short-term routing fix (downgrade batching to avoid latency) 4) Success check 7 days later 5) Renewal touchpoint. Owner: @Priya.

Lee Morgan: Love it. Add explicit downgrade path in case they ask to cut seats: rollback to reserved-capacity plan + reduced token cap, preserve API keys and audit trail. Keep it reversible.

Carlos Ruiz: For routing fix — temporary rule: route large-batch uploads to dedicated pool A with reduced max_batch_size=64. Config snippet:```json
{"route":"skylife-large","max_batch_size":64,"fallback":"hosted-lowcost"}```

Priya Shah: Drafted a short outreach script for the initial enablement invite — feel free to copy/edit:```Hey {{name}},
We noticed activity drop and wanted to offer a 30-min session to review your config and quick wins. Would tomorrow 11am PT work?
Agenda: quick health check, demo of batching tips, one config change.
Thanks, Priya (CS)```

Anika Patel: Nice. Can someone prep a 1-page play summary for the renewal SDR? They want bullets they can send to the account owner.

Lee Morgan: I'll make the 1-pager. Key bullets: reason for outreach, planned fixes (enablement + routing), short downgrade-safe option, success metrics (DAU recovery + latency <300ms), next steps.

Carlos Ruiz: I'll patch the routing rule and monitor. Will post a verification log snippet once done. :white_check_mark:

cs-bot: Incident created: #INC-4361 for Skylife routing alert. Priority: P3. Assigned: Carlos Ruiz.

Priya Shah: After session, we'll capture feedback in this thread and add to playbook library (tag: warm-handoff). Also want to capture ask: did they try prefix caching?

Anika Patel: Great. Timeline: enablement by EOD tomorrow, routing patch within 4 hours of session if needed, success check in 7 days, renewal SDR update 5 days before renewal.

Lee Morgan: I'll post the 1-pager by EOD today and drop the SDR copy into Gainsight.

Carlos Ruiz: Routing patch applied to dev mirror. Smoke test passing. Will promote to prod after workshop.

Priya Shah: Workshop scheduled for 11:00 PT tomorrow with their PM + infra engineer. Adding meeting notes template here after session.

Anika Patel: Thanks team. If this stabilizes usage, we'll formalize the mini-play and add a prebuilt workflow in the CS toolkit. :rocket:
